integrity: Closed-form finite-grid variance and analytic asymptotics; exact rational checker is corroborative, not proof of infinite laws; earlier smooth-function oracle allocation is acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Fixed one-dimensional improper power integrands; one uniform evaluation per independently sampled deterministic power cell; fixed mesh exponent; variance requires 0<alpha<1/2; no optimality claim across arbitrary partitions or algorithms; no independent validation.
title: Gaussian–heavy-tail transition for power-graded randomized quadrature
